# Regulatory authority API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

The shared list of organizations that issue research licenses.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/regulatoryauthority/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/taxonomies/regulatoryauthority/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `regulatoryauthority` (detail, create, update), `regulatoryauthorities` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)
- **Uniqueness:** `name` unique across BrainSTEM
- **Deleting:** refused (400) while [`license`](/api/personal_attributes/license/) records point to it

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 255 characters. Official name of the regulatory authority (e.g., "Home Office", "Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee") |
| `abbreviation` | string; max 32 characters. Common abbreviation (e.g., "IACUC", "AWERB", "IRB", "CCAC") |
| `country` | computed. Country where this authority operates (ISO country code) |
| `authority_type` | one of `national`, `institutional`, `regional`, `international`. Type of regulatory authority |
| `website` | string; max 200 characters. Official website URL |
| `description` | string. Description of the authority, its jurisdiction, and regulatory scope |
| `is_active` | boolean. Whether this authority is currently operational |
| `comments` | string |
| `created_at` | datetime **[read-only]**; nullable |
| `updated_at` | datetime **[read-only]** |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/regulatoryauthority/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('regulatoryauthority', load_all=True)
records = resp['regulatoryauthorities']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('regulatoryauthority', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.regulatoryauthorities;
```

{: .no_toc}

```json

    "regulatoryauthorities": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "name": "Regulatory authority 1",
            "abbreviation": "",
            "country": null,

            "website": "",
            "description": "",
            "is_active": true,
            "comments": "",
            "created_at": "2024-03-22T10:30:00Z",
            "updated_at": "2024-03-22T10:30:00Z",
            "user": "<user-id>"
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/regulatoryauthority/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('regulatoryauthority', data={"name": "Regulatory authority 1"})
record = resp.json()['regulatoryauthority']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Regulatory authority 1'), 'regulatoryauthority');
record = created.regulatoryauthority;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/regulatoryauthority/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('regulatoryauthority', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['regulatoryauthority']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('regulatoryauthority', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.regulatoryauthority;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "regulatoryauthority": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "name": "Regulatory authority 1",
        "abbreviation": "",
        "country": null,
        "authority_type": "national",
        "website": "",
        "description": "",
        "is_active": true,
        "comments": "",
        "created_at": "2024-03-22T10:30:00Z",
        "updated_at": "2024-03-22T10:30:00Z",
        "user": "<user-id>"
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/regulatoryauthority/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('regulatoryauthority', id='<id>', data={"name": "Regulatory authority 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Regulatory authority 1 (renamed)'), 'regulatoryauthority', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/regulatoryauthority/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('regulatoryauthority', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'regulatoryauthority');
```

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Regulatory authority data model page](/datamodel/taxonomies/regulatoryauthority/).
